title: Earn it back: a way home after a broken streak
intro: When a long streak breaks, it resets to zero and the way back costs gems. In June 2026, 15.4 million learners took a one-month offer to revive a lost streak, and they kept learning better than a typical returning group. Then the offer ended. This makes the way back permanent.

today.title: Months of effort shown as 0
today.text: The streak is gone, and repairing it costs gems the learner doesn’t have. Gem numbers are placeholders.

today.title: Home starts from nothing
today.text: Nothing on Home shows the 214 days that came before. Once a goal feels broken, people tend to give up on it.

proposal.title: Paused, not gone
proposal.text: The number stays, in grey. Lifetime effort sits underneath. Two equal choices: earn it back, or start fresh.

proposal.title: A short plan on Home
proposal.text: Three steps, one a day, within a week. The flame shows “214 paused”, never 0.

proposal.title: Day 1 costs no energy
proposal.text: A warm-up built from the learner’s weakest words. A miss is “a bit rusty”, and the answer is shown.

proposal.title: Back, and honest about it
proposal.text: The missed day gets a dashed ring, so a restored streak is never passed off as an unbroken one.

lessons: Treat a break as a pause, not a reset. Keep lifetime effort visible.
Remove friction when people try to come back. That is when they are most motivated and have the least to spend.
Earn it back through practice rather than a purchase, and mark it honestly, so the number still means learning.
test: Does a safety net make people practise less on busy days? If 3 of 5 testers say yes, or say a restored streak “doesn’t count”, the idea needs rethinking.
note: Independent study by Mitul Vaghasiya, not affiliated with Duolingo. Every screen below is my re-creation in Duolingo’s visual style, based on its App Store screenshots (10 Oct 2026) and the public images listed in references/. They are not screenshots of the real app.

compare.title: A broken streak: before and after
compare.question: A learner with a 214-day streak missed Friday. The same moment, two designs.

before.try: Tap Repair streak, then Start a new streak.
before.notice: 214 days become 0, and the way back costs gems the learner doesn’t have.

after.try: Tap Earn it back, do the warm-up, then press Next day and do one lesson a day.
after.notice: The streak is paused, not gone. Day 1 uses no energy, and the restored day keeps an honest mark.
